The decomposition reaction is  

\[
2\,\text{H}_2\text{O}_2 \;\rightarrow\; 2\,\text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{O}_2
\]

Mass is conserved in a closed chemical reaction: the total mass of the products must equal the total mass of the reactants. Heating the 20 g of liquid hydrogen peroxide does not add or remove any matter; it only changes its chemical form. Therefore the combined mass of the liquid water and the oxygen gas produced will be exactly the original 20 g.

**Final answer: D**
